   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">The Company reviews its investments in and advances to unconsolidated joint ventures for other-than-temporary declines in value.&#xa0; To the extent we deem any declines in value of our investment in and advances to unconsolidated joint ventures to be other-than-temporary, we impair our investment accordingly.&#xa0; For the years ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020, </em><em style="font: inherit;">2019</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">2018</em>, the Company recorded other-than-temporary, noncash impairment charges of $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512294" contextRef="d_2020-01-01_2020-12-31_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-UnconsolidatedJointVenturesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanTemporaryImpairment" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">22.3</ix:nonFraction> million, $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512295" contextRef="d_2019-01-01_2019-12-31_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-UnconsolidatedJointVenturesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanTemporaryImpairment" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3">0</ix:nonFraction>,&#xa0;and $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512296" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-12-31_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-UnconsolidatedJointVenturesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanTemporaryImpairment" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">1.1</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively.&#xa0; Joint venture impairment charges are&#xa0;included in equity in net loss&#xa0;of unconsolidated joint ventures in the accompanying consolidated statements of operations.&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">During the <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> <em style="font: inherit;">second</em> quarter, the Company made the determination to exit from its TNHC Russell Ranch LLC ("Russell Ranch") venture due to low expected financial returns relative to the required future capital contributions and related risks, including the potential&#xa0;impact of COVID-<em style="font: inherit;">19</em> on the economy, as well as the Company's opportunity to pursue federal tax loss carryback refund opportunities from the passage of the Coronavirus Relief and Economic Security Act ("CARES Act"). As a result, the Company determined&#xa0;that its investment in the joint venture was <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> recoverable and recorded a <em style="font: inherit;">$20.0</em> million other-than-temporary impairment charge to write off its investment in Russell Ranch and record&#xa0;a liability for&#xa0;its estimated costs to complete&#xa0;the Phase <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> backbone infrastructure costs.&#xa0; The Company believes that exiting the venture preserves capital, reduces its investment concentration within <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> geographical location, and allows it to pursue federal tax loss carryback refunds.&#xa0; The joint venture completed a sale of substantially all of its underlying assets to a <em style="font: inherit;">third</em>-party during the <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> <em style="font: inherit;">fourth</em> quarter that resulted in a the Company recording income of $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512307" contextRef="d_2020-10-01_2020-12-31_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-UnconsolidatedJointVenturesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">4.5</ix:nonFraction> million to equity in income (loss) of unconsolidated joint ventures, partially offsetting the other-than-temporary impairment recorded during the <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> <em style="font: inherit;">second</em> quarter.&#xa0; The remaining <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> other-than-temporary impairment charge&#xa0;of $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512311" contextRef="d_2020-01-01_2020-03-31_ScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis-BedfordMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanTemporaryImpairment" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">2.3</ix:nonFraction> million occurred in the <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> <em style="font: inherit;">first</em> quarter and&#xa0;related to our investment in the Arantine Hills Holdings LP ("Bedford") joint venture.&#xa0;    <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">We maintain general liability insurance designed to protect us against a portion of our risk of loss from construction-related warranty and construction defect claims. Our master general liability policies which cover most of our projects allow for our warranty spend to erode our self-insured retention requirements. We establish and track separately our warranty accrual and litigation reserves for both known and IBNR&#xa0;construction defect claims. Our warranty accrual and litigation reserves for construction defect claims are presented on a gross basis within accrued expenses and other liabilities in the accompanying consolidated balance sheets&#xa0;without consideration of insurance recoveries. Expected recoveries from insurance carriers are tracked separately between warranty insurance receivables and insurance receivables related to litigated claims and are presented within other assets in the accompanying balance sheets. Our warranty accrual and related estimated insurance recoveries are based on historical warranty claim and expense data, and expected recoveries from insurance carriers are recorded based on actual insurance claims and amounts determined using our warranty accrual estimates, our insurance policy coverage limits for the applicable policy years and historical recovery rates. Our litigation reserves for both known and IBNR future construction defect claims based on historical claim and expense data, and expected recoveries from insurance carriers are recorded based on actual insurance claims and amounts determined using our construction defect claim accrual estimates, our insurance policy coverage limits for the applicable policy years and historical recovery rates. Because of the inherent uncertainty and variability in these assumptions, our actual costs and related insurance recoveries could differ significantly from amounts currently estimated.</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes are general senior unsecured obligations that rank equally in right of payment to all existing and future senior indebtedness, including borrowings under the Company's senior unsecured revolving credit facility. The&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes contain certain restrictive covenants, including a limitation on additional indebtedness and a limitation on restricted payments. Restricted payments include, among other things, dividends, investments in unconsolidated entities, and stock repurchases. Under the limitation on incurring or guaranteeing&#xa0;additional indebtedness, we are permitted to incur specified categories of indebtedness but are prohibited, aside from those exceptions, from incurring further indebtedness if we do&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em>&#xa0;satisfy either a leverage condition or an interest coverage condition. Exceptions to the limitation include, among other things, (<em style="font: inherit;">1</em>) borrowings of up to the greater of (i) $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512886" contextRef="i_2020-10-28_DebtInstrumentAxis-SevenTwoFiveSeniorNotesDue2025Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SeniorNotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="nwhm:DebtinstrumentExceptionsToLimitationOnAdditionalIndebtednessMaximumBorrowingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-8">100</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million and (ii)&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c68512887" contextRef="i_2020-10-28_DebtInstrumentAxis-SevenTwoFiveSeniorNotesDue2025Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SeniorNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="nwhm:PercentOfConsolidatedTangibleAssetsGeneralBasketExceptionToLimitationForRestrictedPaymentsToBeMade" scale="-2" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="1">20</ix:nonFraction>% of our consolidated tangible assets under existing or future bank credit facilities, (<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>) non-recourse indebtedness, and (<em style="font: inherit;">3</em>) indebtedness incurred for the purpose of refinancing or repaying certain existing indebtedness. Under the limitation on restricted payments, we are also prohibited from making restricted payments, aside from certain exceptions, if we do&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em>&#xa0;satisfy either the leverage condition or interest coverage condition. In addition, the amount of restricted payments that we can make is subject to an overall basket limitation, which builds based on, among other things,&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c68512891" contextRef="i_2020-10-28_DebtInstrumentAxis-SevenTwoFiveSeniorNotesDue2025Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SeniorNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="nwhm:PercentOfConsolidatedNetIncomeGeneralBasketLimitationForRestrictedPaymentsToBeMade" scale="-2" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="1">50</ix:nonFraction>% of consolidated net income from&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> January 1, 2021&#xa0;</em>forward and&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c68512892" contextRef="i_2020-10-28_DebtInstrumentAxis-SevenTwoFiveSeniorNotesDue2025Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SeniorNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="nwhm:PercentOfNetCashProceedsFromQualifiedEquityOfferingsGeneralBasketLimitationForRestrictedPaymentsToBeMade" scale="-2" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the net cash proceeds from qualified equity offerings. See Note <em style="font: inherit;">18</em> for information about the guarantees.&#xa0; The Indenture contains certain other covenants, among other things, the ability of the Company and its restricted subsidiaries to&#xa0;issue certain equity interests, make payments in respect of subordinated indebtedness, make certain investments, sell assets, incur liens, create certain restrictions on the ability of restricted subsidiaries to pay dividends or to transfer assets, enter into transactions with affiliates, create unrestricted subsidiaries, and consolidate, merge or sell all or substantially all of its assets.&#xa0;These covenants are subject to a number of exceptions and qualifications as set forth in the Indenture.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">In addition, any time prior to&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> October 15, 2022,&#xa0;</em>the Company&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> may,&#xa0;</em>at its option on&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">one</em>&#xa0;or more occasions, redeem the&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes (including any additional notes that&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> may&#xa0;</em>be issued in the future under the Indenture) in an aggregate principal amount&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em>&#xa0;to exceed&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">40%</em>&#xa0;of the aggregate principal amount of the&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes (including any additional notes that&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> may&#xa0;</em>be issued in the future under the Indenture) issued prior to such date at a redemption price (expressed as a percentage of principal amount) of&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c68512910" contextRef="i_2022-10-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-SevenTwoFiveSeniorNotesDue2025Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SeniorNotesMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="Pure" name="nwhm:PercentOfDebtInstrumentFaceAmountValueIssued" scale="-2" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="4">107.25</ix:nonFraction>%, plus accrued and unpaid interest, if any, to the redemption date, with an amount equal to the net cash proceeds from&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">one</em>&#xa0;or more equity offerings by the Company.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt 7.2pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">If the Company experiences a change of control triggering event&#xa0;(as described in the Indenture), holders of the&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes will have the right to require the Company to repurchase all or a portion of the&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes at&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c68512914" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-SevenTwoFiveSeniorNotesDue2025Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SeniorNotesMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ChangeInControlMember" unitRef="Pure" name="nwhm:PercentOfDebtInstrumentFaceAmountValueIssued" scale="-2" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2">101</ix:nonFraction>% of their principal amount thereof on the date of repurchase, plus accrued and unpaid interest, if any, to the date of repurchase (subject to the right of holders of record on the relevant record date to receive interest due on the relevant interest payment date).&#xa0; The Indenture also provides for events of default, which, if any of them occurs, would permit or require the principal of and accrued interest on such&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes to be declared due and payable. In addition, if the&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes are assigned an investment grade rating by certain rating agencies and&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">no</em>&#xa0;default or event of default has occurred or is continuing, certain covenants related to the&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes would be suspended. If the rating on the&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes should subsequently decline to below investment grade, the suspended covenants would be reinstated.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;"><b><i>Credit Facilities</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">The Company had&#xa0;an unsecured revolving credit facility with a bank group (the "existing facility") which, as amended on <em style="font: inherit;"> June 26, 2020, </em>provided for a&#xa0;maturity date of<i>&#xa0;</i><em style="font: inherit;"> September 30, 2021 </em>and&#xa0;total commitments under the facility of $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512920" contextRef="i_2020-06-26_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-7">60</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million&#xa0;and an&#xa0;accordion feature allowing up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512921" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_CreditFacilityAxis-AccordionFeatureMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-7">150</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million of borrowings, subject to certain financial conditions, including the availability of bank commitments.&#xa0; The existing facility, as amended in <em style="font: inherit;"> June 2020, </em>also provided a $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512922" contextRef="i_2020-06-26_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_DebtInstrumentAxis-LettersOfCreditSublimitMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million sublimit for letters of credit, subject to conditions set forth in the agreement. As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2019,&#xa0;</em>the Company had <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68512923">no</span> outstanding letters of credit issued under the existing facility.&#xa0; Debt issuance costs for the existing unsecured revolving credit facility, which totaled $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512924" contextRef="i_2019-12-31_CreditFacilityAxis-RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNet" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">0.5</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2019 </em>were&#xa0;included in other assets and amortized and capitalized to interest costs on a straight-line basis over the term of the agreement. The existing facility was terminated in connection with the Company's execution of the New Credit Agreement discussed below.</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">On&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> April 15, 2020,&#xa0;</em>TNHC Realty and Construction, Inc., a wholly-owned operating subsidiary of the Company, received approval and funding pursuant to a promissory note evidencing an unsecured loan in the amount of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c68512954" contextRef="d_2020-04-15_2020-04-15" unitRef="USD" name="nwhm:ProceedsFromPaycheckProtectionProgramUnderCARESAct" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6">7.0</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million (the "Loan") under the Paycheck Protection Program (the "PPP").&#xa0; The PPP was established under the CARES Act and is administered by the U.S. Small Business Administration ("SBA").&#xa0; The Company intended to use the Loan for qualifying expenses in accordance with the terms of the CARES Act.&#xa0; On&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> April 23, 2020,&#xa0;</em>the SBA, in consultation with the Department of Treasury, issued new guidance that created uncertainty regarding the&#xa0;qualification requirements for a PPP loan.&#xa0; On&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> April 24, 2020,&#xa0;</em>out of an abundance of caution, the Company elected to repay the Loan and&#xa0;initiated a repayment of the full amount of the Loan to the lender.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">10.</em>&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;Fair Value Disclosures</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">ASC <em style="font: inherit;">820</em>&#xa0;defines fair value as the price that would be received for selling an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market participants at measurement date and requires assets and liabilities carried at fair value to be classified and disclosed in the following <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> categories:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px;"><tbody><tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 45pt;">&#xa0;</td><td style="width: 18pt;"> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#x2022;</p> </td><td> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> &#x2013; Quoted prices for identical instruments in active markets</p> </td></tr>
<tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 45pt;">&#xa0;</td><td style="width: 18pt;"> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#x2022;</p> </td><td> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">Level <em style="font: inherit;">2</em> &#x2013; Quoted prices for similar instruments in active markets; quoted prices for identical or similar instruments in markets that are inactive; and model-derived valuations in which all significant inputs and significant value drivers are observable in active markets at measurement date</p> </td></tr>
<tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 45pt;">&#xa0;</td><td style="width: 18pt;"> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#x2022;</p> </td><td> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> &#x2013; Valuations derived from techniques where <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> or more significant inputs or significant value drivers are unobservable in active markets at measurement date</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p><ix:exclude><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">As an owner and developer of real estate, the Company is subject to various environmental laws of federal, state and local governments. The Company is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> aware of any environmental liability that could have a material adverse effect on its financial condition or results of operations. However, changes in applicable environmental laws and regulations, the uses and conditions of real estate in the vicinity of the Company&#x2019;s real estate and other environmental conditions of which the Company is unaware with respect to the real estate could result in future environmental liabilities.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">The Company has provided credit enhancements in connection with certain joint venture borrowings in the form of loan-to-value ("LTV") maintenance agreements in order to secure the joint venture's performance under the loans and maintenance of certain LTV ratios.&#xa0; For unconsolidated joint ventures where the Company provided LTV enhancements,&#xa0;the&#xa0;Company has also entered into agreements with some of its unconsolidated joint venture&#xa0;partners whereby the Company and its partners are apportioned liability under the LTV maintenance agreements according to their respective capital interest. In addition, these agreements provide the Company, to the extent its partner has an unpaid liability under such LTV credit enhancements, the right to receive distributions from the unconsolidated joint venture that would otherwise be made to the partner. However, there is <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> guarantee that such distributions will be made or will be sufficient to cover the Company's liability under such LTV maintenance agreements. The loans underlying the LTV maintenance agreements include&#xa0;acquisition and development loans, construction revolvers and model home loans, and the agreements remain in force until the loans are satisfied. Due to the nature of the loans, the outstanding balance at any given time is subject to a number of factors including the status of site improvements, the mix of horizontal and vertical development underway, the timing of phase build outs, and the period necessary to complete the escrow process for homebuyers. As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em>, $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513121" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_GuaranteeObligationsByNatureAxis-FinancialGuaranteeMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-CorporateJointVentureMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3">0</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;and $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513122" contextRef="i_2019-12-31_GuaranteeObligationsByNatureAxis-FinancialGuaranteeMember_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-CorporateJointVentureMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">28.6</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million, respectively, was outstanding under loans that are credit enhanced by the Company through LTV maintenance agreements. Under the terms of the joint venture agreements, the Company's proportionate share of LTV maintenance agreement liabilities was $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513123" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-CorporateJointVentureMember_UnderlyingAssetClassAxis-LoansPayableMember" unitRef="USD" name="nwhm:RelatedPartyTransactionGuarantorObligationsUnderlyingAssetClassGuaranteed" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3">0</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;and $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513124" contextRef="i_2019-12-31_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-CorporateJointVentureMember_UnderlyingAssetClassAxis-LoansPayableMember" unitRef="USD" name="nwhm:RelatedPartyTransactionGuarantorObligationsUnderlyingAssetClassGuaranteed" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">5.8</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million, respectively, as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em>.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">In addition, the Company has provided completion agreements regarding specific performance for certain joint venture projects whereby the Company is required to complete the given project with funds provided by the beneficiary of the agreement. If there are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> adequate funds available under the specific project loans, the Company would then be subject to financial liability under such completion agreements. Typically, under such terms of the joint venture agreements, the Company has the right to apportion the respective share of any costs funded under such completion agreements to its partners. However, there is <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> guarantee that we will be able to recover against our partners for such amounts owed to us under the terms of such joint venture agreements. In connection with joint venture borrowings, the Company also selectively provides (a) an environmental indemnity to the lender that holds the lender harmless from and against losses arising from the discharge of hazardous materials from the property and non-compliance with applicable environmental laws; and (b) indemnification of the lender from "bad boy acts" of the unconsolidated entity such as fraud, misrepresentation, misapplication or non-payment of rents, profits, insurance, and condemnation proceeds, waste and mechanic liens, and bankruptcy.</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">The Company accounts for contracts deemed to contain a lease under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">842,</em> <i>Leases</i>. At the inception of a lease, or if a lease is subsequently modified, we determine whether the lease is an operating or financing lease. Our lease population is fully comprised of operating leases and includes leases for certain office space and equipment for use in our operations. For all leases with an expected term that exceeds <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> year, right-of-use lease assets and lease liabilities are recorded within our&#xa0;consolidated balance sheets. The depreciable lives of right-of-use lease assets are limited to the expected term which would include any renewal options we expect to exercise. The exercise of lease renewal options is generally at our discretion and we expect that in the normal course of business, leases that expire will be renewed or replaced by other leases. Our lease agreements do <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> contain any residual value guarantees or material restrictive covenants.&#xa0; Variable lease payments consist of non-lease services related to the lease.&#xa0; Variable lease payments are&#xa0;excluded from the right-of-use lease assets and lease liabilities and are expensed as incurred.&#xa0;&#xa0;Right-of-use lease assets are included in other assets and totaled $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513143" contextRef="i_2020-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6">3.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513144" contextRef="i_2019-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6">2.0</ix:nonFraction> million at <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2019,</em> respectively.&#xa0; Lease liabilities are recorded in accrued expenses and other liabilities and totaled $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513146" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_BalanceSheetLocationAxis-AccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherLiabilitiesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLiability" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">3.2</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513147" contextRef="i_2019-12-31_BalanceSheetLocationAxis-AccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherLiabilitiesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLiability" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">2.2</ix:nonFraction> million&#xa0;at <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2019,</em> respectively.&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 27pt;">In its ordinary course of business, the Company enters into agreements to purchase lots from unconsolidated land development joint ventures of which it is a member. In accordance with ASC&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">360</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">20,</em> <i>Property Plant and Equipment - Real Estate Sales</i>,&#xa0;the Company defers its portion of the underlying gain from the joint venture's sale of these lots to the Company. When the Company purchases lots directly from the joint venture, the deferred gain is recorded as a reduction to the Company's land basis on the purchased lots. In this instance, the gain is ultimately recognized when the Company delivers lots to&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">third</em>-party home buyers at the time of the home closing.&#xa0; In the instance where the Company <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> longer has an interest in the unconsolidated joint venture, the deferred gain related to lots purchased from the joint venture is recognized upon the Company's exit of the venture.&#xa0; At <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020, </em>$<ix:nonFraction id="c68513288" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TNHCHWCanneryLLCMember" unitRef="USD" name="nwhm:DeferredProfitFromLotTransactions" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">0.1</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million of deferred gain from lot transactions with the TNHC-HW Cannery LLC (the "Cannery")&#xa0;unconsolidated joint venture remained unrecognized and included as a reduction to land basis in the accompanying consolidated balance sheets.&#xa0; At <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2019, </em>$<ix:nonFraction id="c68513289" contextRef="i_2019-12-31_RelatedPartyTransactionsByRelatedPartyAxis-TNHCHWCanneryLLCMember" unitRef="USD" name="nwhm:DeferredProfitFromLotTransactions" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">0.2</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;million of deferred gain&#xa0;from lot transactions with the Cannery and Bedford unconsolidated joint ventures remained unrecognized and included as a reduction to land basis in the accompanying consolidated balance sheets.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">13.</em>&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;Stock-Based Compensation</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">The Company's <em style="font: inherit;">2014</em> Long-Term Incentive Plan (the <em style="font: inherit;">"2014</em> Incentive Plan"), was adopted by our board of directors in <em style="font: inherit;"> January 2014. </em>The <em style="font: inherit;">2014</em> Incentive Plan provides for the grant of equity-based awards, including options to purchase shares of common stock, stock appreciation rights, restricted and unrestricted stock awards, restricted stock units and performance awards. The <em style="font: inherit;">2014</em> Incentive Plan will automatically expire on the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513464">tenth</span> anniversary of its effective date.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">The number of shares of our common stock authorized to be issued under the <em style="font: inherit;">2014</em> Incentive Plan is <ix:nonFraction id="c68513466" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_PlanNameAxis-The2014IncentivePlanMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized" scale="0" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF">1,644,875</ix:nonFraction> shares. To the extent that shares of the Company's common stock subject to an outstanding award&#xa0;granted under the <em style="font: inherit;">2014</em> Incentive Plan or any predecessor plan are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> issued or delivered by reason of the expiration, termination, cancellation or forfeiture of such award or the settlement of such award in cash, then such shares of common stock generally shall again be available under the <em style="font: inherit;">2014</em> Incentive Plan.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">At our <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em> Annual Meeting of Shareholders on <em style="font: inherit;"> May 24, 2016, </em>our shareholders approved the Company's <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em> Incentive Award Plan (the <em style="font: inherit;">"2016</em> Incentive Plan"). The <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em> Incentive Plan provides for the grant of stock options, stock appreciation rights, restricted stock, restricted stock units and other stock- or cash-based awards. Non-employee directors of the Company and employees and consultants of the Company, or any of its subsidiaries, are eligible to receive awards under the <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em> Incentive Plan. On <em style="font: inherit;"> May 22, 2018, </em>our shareholders approved the amended and restated <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em> Incentive Plan which increased the number of shares authorized for issuance under the plan from <ix:nonFraction id="c68513476" contextRef="i_2016-05-24_PlanNameAxis-The2016IncentivePlanAmendedAndRestatedMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized" scale="0" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF">800,000</ix:nonFraction> to <ix:nonFraction id="c68513477" contextRef="i_2018-05-22_PlanNameAxis-The2016IncentivePlanAmendedAndRestatedMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAuthorized" scale="0" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF">2,100,000</ix:nonFraction> shares. The amended and restated <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em> Incentive Plan will expire on <em style="font: inherit;"> April 4, 2028.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">The Company has issued stock options and restricted stock unit awards under the <em style="font: inherit;">2014</em> Incentive Plan and stock options, restricted stock unit awards and performance share unit awards under the <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em> Incentive Plan. As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020</em>, <ix:nonFraction id="c68513481" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_PlanNameAxis-The2014IncentivePlanMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant" scale="0" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF">70,244</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;shares&#xa0;remain available for grant under the <em style="font: inherit;">2014</em> Incentive Plan and <ix:nonFraction id="c68513483" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_PlanNameAxis-The2016IncentivePlanMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant" scale="0" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF">415,592</ix:nonFraction> shares&#xa0;remain available&#xa0;for grant under the <em style="font: inherit;">2016</em> Incentive Plan. The exercise price of stock option&#xa0;awards <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em><em style="font: inherit;">not</em> be less than the market value of the Company's common stock on the date of grant. The fair value for stock options is established at the date of grant using the Black-Scholes model for time-based vesting awards. The Company's stock options, restricted stock unit awards, and performance share unit awards typically vest over a <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513486">one</span> year to <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513487">three</span> years period and the stock options expire <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513488">ten</span> years from the date of grant.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p><ix:exclude><p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;"></p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">We used the "simplified method" to establish the expected term of the common stock options granted by the Company. Our restricted stock unit awards and performance share unit awards are valued based on the closing price of our common stock on the date of grant. The number of performance share units that would vest ranged&#xa0;from <ix:nonFraction id="c68513501" contextRef="d_2020-01-01_2020-12-31_AwardTypeAxis-PerformanceSharesMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="Pure" name="nwhm:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardVestRangePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="1">50</ix:nonFraction>%-<ix:nonFraction id="c68513502" contextRef="d_2020-01-01_2020-12-31_AwardTypeAxis-PerformanceSharesMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="Pure" name="nwhm:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardVestRangePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="1">150</ix:nonFraction>% of the target amount awarded based on actual cumulative earnings per share and return on equity growth from <em style="font: inherit;">2018</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">2019,</em> subject to initial achievement of minimum thresholds. We evaluated the probability of achieving the performance targets established under each of the outstanding performance share unit awards quarterly during <em style="font: inherit;">2018</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">2019</em>&#xa0;and estimated the number of underlying units that were&#xa0;probable of being issued. Compensation expense for restricted stock unit and performance share unit awards was&#xa0;being recognized using the straight-line method over the requisite service period, subject to cumulative catch-up adjustments required as a result of changes in the number shares probable of being issued for performance share unit awards.&#xa0; Forfeitures are recognized in compensation cost during the period that the award forfeiture occurs.&#xa0; For the years ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020, </em><em style="font: inherit;">2019</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">2018,</em> <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513509"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513517"><span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513518">no</span></span></span> expense was recognized for our performance share units.&#xa0; At <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2019,&#xa0;</em>the performance targets associated with the outstanding performance share unit awards were <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> met and all outstanding awards were forfeited.&#xa0;&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">At <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020</em>, the amount of unearned stock-based compensation currently estimated to be expensed through <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>&#xa0;<span style="background-color:#ffffff;">is $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513512" contextRef="i_2020-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognized" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">2.4</ix:nonFraction>&#xa0;m</span>illion. The weighted-average period over which the unearned stock-based compensation is expected to be recognized is<span style="background-color:#ffffff;"> <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2020-01-01_2020-12-31" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedPeriodForRecognition1" id="c68513513" format="ixt-sec:duryear">1.6</ix:nonNumeric>&#xa0;ye</span>ars. If there are any modifications or cancellations of the underlying unvested awards, the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be required to accelerate, increase or cancel any remaining unearned stock-based compensation expense.</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">14.</em> &#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;Income Taxes </b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>

   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#xa0;</p></ix:exclude><ix:exclude></ix:exclude>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">The Company's effective tax rate&#xa0;for <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> includes the&#xa0;benefit associated with net operating loss carrybacks to years when the Company was subject to a <em style="font: inherit;">35%</em> federal tax rate as permitted by the CARES Act.&#xa0; The CARES Act was signed into law on <em style="font: inherit;"> March 27, 2020 </em>and&#xa0;allows companies to carry back net operating losses generated in <em style="font: inherit;">2018</em> through&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> for <em style="font: inherit;">five</em> years.&#xa0;&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">With the enactment of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (the "Tax Act"), the corporate federal income tax rate dropped from a maximum of <em style="font: inherit;">35%</em> to a flat <em style="font: inherit;">21%</em> rate effective <em style="font: inherit;"> January 1, 2018.&#xa0; </em>As a result of the rate change, the Company was required to revalue its net deferred tax asset at <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2018&#xa0;</em>and recorded a provisional adjustment to reduce its value by $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513668" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxCutsAndJobsActOf2017ChangeInTaxRateIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">3.2</ix:nonFraction> million. The Company completed its accounting for the tax effects of the Tax Act in <em style="font: inherit;">2018,</em> within the <em style="font: inherit;">one</em>-year measurement period prescribed by the SEC, and recorded a $<ix:nonFraction id="c68513673" contextRef="d_2018-01-01_2018-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxCutsAndJobsActOf2017MeasurementPeriodAdjustmentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit" scale="6" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5">0.1</ix:nonFraction> million adjustment to the provisional amount.</p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#xa0;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">15.</em>&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;&#xa0;Segment Information</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">The Company&#x2019;s operations are organized into <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513802">three</span> reportable segments: <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c68513803">two</span> homebuilding segments (Arizona and California) and fee building.&#xa0; In determining the most appropriate reportable segments, we considered similar economic and other characteristics, including product types, average selling prices, gross margins, production processes, suppliers, subcontractors, regulatory environments, land position, and underlying demand and supply in accordance with ASC&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">280.</em>&#xa0;&#xa0;Our California homebuilding reportable segment aggregates the Southern California and Northern&#xa0;California homebuilding operating segments</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">Our homebuilding operations acquire and develop land and construct and sell single-family attached and detached homes and <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>sell land. Our fee building operations build homes and manage construction and sales related activities on behalf of <em style="font: inherit;">third</em>-party property owners and our joint ventures.&#xa0; While our corporate operations conduct <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> independent construction, development, sales or land acquisition activities,&#xa0;our corporate operations develop and implement strategic initiatives and support our operating segments by centralizing key administrative functions such as accounting, finance and treasury, information technology, insurance and risk management, litigation, marketing and human resources.&#xa0; A portion of the expenses incurred by corporate are allocated to the fee building segment primarily based on its respective percentage of revenues and to each homebuilding segment based on its respective investment in and advances to unconsolidated joint ventures and real estate inventories balances.&#xa0; The majority of our corporate personnel and resources are primarily dedicated to activities relating to our homebuilding segment, and, therefore, the balance of any unallocated corporate expenses are allocated within&#xa0;our homebuilding reportable segments.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">Corporate unallocated assets consists&#xa0;primarily of cash, prepaid taxes and our deferred tax asset.&#xa0; For cash management efficiency and yield maximization&#xa0;reasons, cash is held at the corporate level.&#xa0; All cash is held for the benefit of the subsidiaries that comprise the homebuilding and fee building segments,&#xa0;and all operating cash flow is&#xa0;generated by these subsidiaries.&#xa0; The majority of our prepaid taxes and deferred tax asset are recorded at the corporate level as The New Home Company Inc. is the tax-filing entity for the subsidiaries structured as pass-through entities.&#xa0; Taxable income or loss and the resulting payment of income taxes&#xa0;is driven by the activities of the Company's subsidiaries.&#xa0; All other corporate assets comprise less than <em style="font: inherit;">3%</em> of the Company's consolidated total assets.&#xa0; The assets of our fee building segment primarily consist of cash, restricted cash and contracts and accounts receivable.</p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:27pt;">The reportable segments follow the same accounting policies as our consolidated financial statements described in Note <em style="font: inherit;">1.</em> Operational results of each reportable segment are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> necessarily indicative of the results that would have been achieved had the reportable segment been an independent, stand-alone entity during the periods presented. Financial information relating to reportable segments was as follows:</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;"><b><em style="font: inherit;">18.</em> Supplemental Guarantor Information&#xa0;</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 36pt;">The&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes and the guarantees are the Company&#x2019;s and the Guarantor&#x2019;s senior unsecured obligations. The&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes and the guarantees rank equally in right of payment with all of the Company&#x2019;s and the Guarantors&#x2019; existing and future unsecured senior debt, including borrowings under the Company's Credit Facility, and senior in right of payment to all of the Company&#x2019;s and the Guarantors&#x2019; existing and future subordinated debt. The&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes and the guarantees will be effectively subordinated to any of the Company&#x2019;s and the Guarantors&#x2019; existing and future secured debt.&#xa0;The&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes are guaranteed, on an unsecured basis, jointly and severally, by all of the Company's wholly owned subsidiaries (collectively, the "Guarantors"). The guarantees are full and unconditional. The Indenture governing the&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">2025</em>&#xa0;Notes provides that the guarantee&#xa0;of a Guarantor will be automatically and unconditionally released and discharged: (<em style="font: inherit;">1</em>) upon any sale, transfer, exchange or other disposition (by merger, consolidation or otherwise) of all of the equity interests of such Guarantor after which the applicable Guarantor is&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">no</em>&#xa0;longer a "Restricted Subsidiary" (as defined in the Indenture), which sale, transfer, exchange or other disposition is made in compliance with applicable provisions of the Indenture; (<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>) upon the proper designation of such Guarantor as an "Unrestricted Subsidiary" (as defined in the Indenture), in accordance with the Indenture; (<em style="font: inherit;">3</em>) upon request of the Company and certification in an officers&#x2019; certificate provided to the trustee that the applicable Guarantor has become an "Immaterial Subsidiary" (as defined in the Indenture), so long as such Guarantor would&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em>&#xa0;otherwise be required to provide a guarantee pursuant to the Indenture; provided that, if immediately after giving effect to such release the consolidated tangible assets of all Immaterial Subsidiaries that are&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em>&#xa0;Guarantors would exceed&#xa0;<ix:nonFraction id="c68514112" contextRef="i_2020-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-SeniorNotesDue2022Member_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-SeniorNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="nwhm:DebtInstrumentConditionsOfGuaranteeReleasePercentageOfTangibleAssetsAttributableToImmaterialSubsidiariesThresholdForNoRelease" scale="-2" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="2">5</ix:nonFraction>% of consolidated tangible assets,&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">no</em>&#xa0;such release shall occur, (<em style="font: inherit;">4</em>) if the Company exercises its legal defeasance option or covenant defeasance option under the Indenture or if the obligations of the Company and the Guarantors are discharged in compliance with applicable provisions of the Indenture; (<em style="font: inherit;">5</em>) unless a default has occurred and is continuing, upon the release or discharge of such Guarantor from its guarantee of any indebtedness for borrowed money of the Company or any other&#xa0;Guarantor&#xa0;so long as such Guarantor would&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;">not</em>&#xa0;then otherwise be required to provide a guarantee pursuant to the Indenture; or (<em style="font: inherit;">6</em>) upon the full satisfaction of the Company&#x2019;s obligations under the Indenture; provided that in each case if such Guarantor has incurred any indebtedness in reliance on its status as a Guarantor in compliance with applicable provisions of the Indenture, such Guarantor&#x2019;s obligations under such indebtedness, as the case&#xa0;<em style="font: inherit;"> may&#xa0;</em>be, so incurred are satisfied in full and discharged or are otherwise permitted to be incurred by a Restricted Subsidiary (other than a Guarantor) in compliance with applicable provisions of the Indenture.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:left;text-indent:36pt;">&#xa0;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 27pt;">The New Home Company Inc.&#xa0;operates as a holding company and all of its homebuilding construction, fee building, development and sales activities are conducted through its subsidiaries.&#xa0; Since the issuance of the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Notes in <em style="font: inherit;">2017,</em> the Company has had only <em style="font: inherit;">one</em> subsidiary, a&#xa0;consolidated&#xa0;joint venture,&#xa0;that was <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> a Guarantor.&#xa0; During the <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em> <em style="font: inherit;">third</em> quarter, and prior to the issuance of the <em style="font: inherit;">2025</em> Notes,&#xa0;this entity was dissolved.&#xa0; &#xa0;At <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2020,&#xa0;</em>all of the Company's subsidiaries were <em style="font: inherit;">100%</em> owned subsidiaries and Guarantors.&#xa0;&#xa0;The Company has <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> provided condensed consolidated financial information of the Guarantors because the parent company, The New Home Company&#xa0;Inc. has <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> independent assets or operations&#xa0;and the guarantees of its subsidiaries are full unconditional and joint and several and, accordingly, the presentation of such information is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> material.&#xa0; For more information regarding the Company's assets and operations, please see Note <em style="font: inherit;">15.</em></p>
